[compiler:gccgo] skip

go build -isolate-config=isolate.json -o lifecycle$GOEXE ./host
exec ./lifecycle$GOEXE
stdout '^compiled lifecycle passed$'

# The same contract holds with instrumented entry closures and dependencies.
[cgo] [race] go build -isolate-config=isolate.json -race -o lifecycle-race$GOEXE ./host
[cgo] [race] exec ./lifecycle-race$GOEXE
[cgo] [race] stdout '^compiled lifecycle passed$'

# A generated state factory whose initializer never returns is cancellable.
go build -isolate-config=isolate.json -o startup-worker$GOEXE ./startup
exec ./startup-worker$GOEXE
stdout '^compiled startup canceled$'

-- go.mod --
module example.org/lifecycle
go 1.26
-- jobs/jobs.go --
package jobs
import (
    "iter"
    "encoding/json"
    "os"
    "runtime"
)
var state = make([]byte, 1<<20)
func Decode(data []byte, dst any) error { return json.Unmarshal(data, dst) }

// Explicit isolate entry in isolate.json.
func Work(mode string) (string, error) {
    state[0]++
    switch mode {
    case "panic": panic("root panic")
    case "child": go func() { panic("child panic") }(); select {}
    case "goexit": runtime.Goexit()
    case "exit": os.Exit(17)
    case "recover":
        finished := make(chan struct{})
        go func() { defer close(finished); runtime.Goexit() }()
        <-finished
        func() { defer func() { if recover() != "ordinary" { panic("lost recovery") } }(); panic("ordinary") }()
    case "range recover":
        func() {
            defer func() {
                for range func(yield func(int) bool) { yield(0) } {
                    if recover() != "ordinary range" { panic("lost range recovery") }
                }
            }()
            panic("ordinary range")
        }()
    case "children":
        entered := make(chan struct{})
        for range 32 { go func() { entered <- struct{}{}; select {} }() }
        for range 32 { <-entered }
        _, stop := iter.Pull(func(yield func(int) bool) { yield(1) })
        runtime.KeepAlive(stop)
    }
    if state[0] != 1 { panic("private package state shared") }
    return "finished", nil
}
-- host/main.go --
package main
import (
    "context"
    "encoding/json"
    "errors"
    "fmt"
    "isolate"
    "strings"
    "time"
    "example.org/lifecycle/jobs"
)
func run(mode string, deterministic bool) {
    handle, ok := isolate.LookupFunction(jobs.Work)
    if !ok { panic("missing handle") }
    program := handle.ProgramWithHandle(func(h isolate.Handle) {
        data, err := isolate.Call(1, nil)
        if err != nil { panic(err) }
        err = h.Invoke(func(values ...isolate.Value) error { return jobs.Decode(data, values[0].Pointer) }, func(values ...isolate.Value) error {
            if values[0].Value != "finished" { panic("invalid result") }
            return nil
        })
        if err != nil { panic(err) }
    })
    clock := time.Unix(0, 0)
    i, err := isolate.New(isolate.Config{Program: program, Deterministic: deterministic, InitialTime: &clock, TimerOp: 99})
    if err != nil { panic(err) }
    if err := i.Start(); err != nil { panic(err) }
    data, _ := json.Marshal(mode)
    (<-i.Commands()).Reply(data, nil)
    select { case <-i.Done(): case <-time.After(5*time.Second): panic("group did not drain") }
    err = i.Wait()
    switch mode {
    case "panic", "child":
        var failure *isolate.PanicError
        phase, message := "main", "root panic"
        if mode == "child" { phase, message = "goroutine", "child panic" }
        if !errors.As(err, &failure) || failure.Phase != phase || failure.Message != message || !strings.Contains(failure.Stack, "jobs.Work") { panic(err) }
    case "goexit":
        var failure *isolate.GoexitError
        if !errors.As(err, &failure) || failure.Phase != "main" { panic(err) }
    case "exit":
        var failure *isolate.ExitError
        if !errors.As(err, &failure) || failure.Code != 17 { panic(err) }
    default: if err != nil { panic(err) }
    }
    if err := i.Kill(context.Background()); err != nil { panic(err) }
    if err := i.Start(); err == nil { panic("revived completed isolate") }
}
func main() {
    for _, deterministic := range []bool{false,true} {
        for _, mode := range []string{"panic", "child", "goexit", "exit", "recover", "range recover", "children"} { run(mode, deterministic) }
    }
    fmt.Println("compiled lifecycle passed")
}
-- blocked/blocked.go --
package blocked

import "isolate"

func init() {
    if isolate.IsActive() {
        select {}
    }
}

// Explicit isolate entry in isolate.json.
func Wait() error { return nil }
-- startup/main.go --
package main
import (
    "context"
    "errors"
    "fmt"
    "isolate"
    "time"
    "example.org/lifecycle/blocked"
)
func main() {
    handle, ok := isolate.LookupFunction(blocked.Wait)
    if !ok { panic("missing startup workflow") }
    ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 20*time.Millisecond)
    defer cancel()
    program := handle.ProgramWithHandle(func(isolate.Handle) {})
    instance, err := isolate.NewContext(ctx, isolate.Config{Program:program})
    if instance != nil || !errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) { panic(err) }
    fmt.Println("compiled startup canceled")
}
